title: The underground/tunnels
content: In my mall world, I've encountered two eerie and unsettling openings on the 'ground floor' that leave me with a sense of dread. The first is a massive, seemingly endless pit in a vast warehouse. Despite the presence of a bulldozer and piles of white dirt, there's never anyone working on the site, giving the impression of a abandoned mine shaft. The feeling of unease is palpable, like who ever created the hole has made a huge mistake. The second discovery is a network of caves, accessible through metal stairs in restricted areas. These cavernous rooms are filled with workers moving earth and massive machinery, with giant garage doors leading outside. However, my explorations always lead me to a smaller, concrete room with dirt floors, which conceal a hollow space beneath. Removing the thin sheet metal reveals a labyrinth of caves, complete with broken wooden beams and stairs descending into a vast, dark reddish void. Each time I stumble upon these underground spaces, I'm overcome with a sense of impending doom. I'm curious to know if anyone else has had similar experiences with the underground.
